output_list.criticism: The transferOwnership function is public and can be called by anyone. It should be modified to only be callable by the owner.

output_list.vulnerability: Unsafe use of the transferFrom function
output_list.criticism: The transferFrom function does not check if the sender has enough allowance to transfer the tokens. This can lead to a reentrancy attack.

output_list.vulnerability: Unsafe use of the approve function
output_list.criticism: The approve function does not check if the spender is the owner of the tokens. This can lead to a reentrancy attack.

output_list.vulnerability: Unsafe use of the balanceOf function
output_list.criticism: The balanceOf function does not check if the address is a contract. This can lead to a reentrancy attack.

output_list.vulnerability: Unsafe use of the allowance function
output_list.criticism: The allowance function does not check if the owner is the owner of the tokens. This can lead to a reentrancy attack.
